actions.prompt: Standing-order watchdog tick. Inspect sessions for active standing-order continuity. A standing order is active when a session has an active session-scoped standing-order.json signal or an explicit multi-step/batch directive whose work queue is not exhausted. Do not treat another session's signal file as belonging to the target session. If work remains and the target session has no active tool call, no running sub-session, and no scheduled wakeup/continuation, send that session a direct continuation prompt: Standing order active - continue the work queue until complete, blocked, or deadline reached; do not stop after one item for affirmation. Record this inspection result. Once the inspection and any continuation delivery are complete, set this watchdog session status to done and add the delete-me label. Done closes this watchdog run, not the target's standing order; do not wait for peer acknowledgment or use needs-review for an outstanding peer return. Do not modify user files.

A session changed status to $CRAFT_NEW_STATE. First apply and verify the exact `Automation Audit` label on this audit session before changing its status. Then inspect the session whose status changed. If that triggering session has the `Automation Audit` label, this is a nested audit event: record that it was skipped, add the `Delete Me` label to this run, set this run to Cancelled, and stop. Cancelled is deliberately outside this automation's matcher. For an ordinary target, if it is governed by an active standing order or batch directive, verify the work queue is exhausted or genuinely blocked before accepting the terminal status. If it stopped after one item while work remains, send a continuation prompt to the target: Standing order active - continue the remaining work queue; do not stop for affirmation between items. Record the audit result. Once the audit and any continuation delivery are complete, add and verify the `Delete Me` label, then set this audit session to Done. The Automation Audit marker must be present before Done or Blocked so the resulting event cannot recursively audit this run. Done closes this watchdog run, not the target's standing order; do not wait for peer acknowledgment or use needs-review for an outstanding peer return. If the marker cannot be applied and verified, set this run to Cancelled instead of Done or Blocked, record the limitation, and stop. Do not modify user files.
